questions.prompt: The model edits AGENTS.md successfully. When does it see the new text?
options: Never, because the harness reads the file only once
At the next step, as an updated instructions note
Immediately, inside the edit tool result
questions.explanation: The tools/result listener records the touched path. At the next pre-step, the listener sees that the text changed and adds an updated note.

questions.prompt: Why does the harness keep the text the model last saw for each file?
options: To add a note only when the file really changed
To restore the file if the model breaks it
To send the old text with each request
To count the tokens in the file
questions.explanation: A read also touches the path. Comparing with the last seen text means no note is added when nothing changed.

questions.prompt: An edit to AGENTS.md fails with an error result. What does the listener do?
options: It adds an updated note anyway
It records nothing, because only successful results count
questions.explanation: The tools/result listener only records a path when the result is not an error, so a failed edit changes nothing.
